banner.title: xe-gpu-exporter
banner.tagline: Exports Intel xe VRAM use per card and per pod on every node, read from DRM fdinfo, because the xe driver publishes no VRAM counters in sysfs.

art.about: a process walker that reads GPU memory from file descriptor metadata
art.title: How xe-gpu-exporter reads VRAM

explainer.title: From every DRM file descriptor to one gauge per card

steps.title: Scan
steps.text: Each scrape of /metrics walks every /proc/<pid> on the node. Nothing is cached, so each reading is live.
steps.scene: an eye sweeping rows of process cards

steps.title: Find
steps.text: For each process it reads fd links and keeps the ones pointing at a /dev/dri renderD or card node, then reads their fdinfo.
steps.scene: linked file descriptors leading to a GPU

steps.title: Sum
steps.text: Only clients with drm-driver xe count, once each. It adds drm-total-vram0 and drm-total-gtt per card and per pod UID.
steps.scene: memory blocks stacking into one column

steps.title: Export
steps.text: It emits xe_gpu_vram_used_bytes, xe_gpu_gtt_used_bytes, xe_gpu_clients and per-process series. The card total comes from XE_VRAM_TOTALS_MIB.
steps.scene: a rising chart on a neon panel
